title: Lair
subtitle: Your base of operations
emptyState: No schemes yet. Every empire starts with a single evil plan.
sharkTank.hungry: The sharks are hungry. Please don't stand so close.
selfDestruct.confirm: Start the self-destruct sequence? The lair will be destroyed in {{minutes}} minutes. Minions will be evacuated through the secret tunnel, the sharks will be released into the sea, and none of this can be undone once the countdown begins.
selfDestructAborted: Self-destruct aborted. Everyone can breathe again.
camerasPrivacyNote: Cameras record every room except the minion break room, by union agreement. Footage is kept for {{days}} days and then quietly deleted, unless a hero appears in it, in which case it goes straight to the highlights reel.
tunnelHint: Behind the bookcase. Pull the third book, not the second.
volcanoVentHelp: Venting lets off pressure before it builds up under the lair. Schedule it for quiet hours: the rumbling upsets the sharks, and neighbouring heroes tend to notice the smoke.
powerWarning: The death ray is using {{percent}}% of the lair's power.
guestListEmpty: No guests expected. Captured heroes don't count.
